decisionsTitle: Every race's «când» is a list where its own box is too narrow for one line — one named time too (amends §600)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-01 07:40, a phone screenshot of the race's card on production** — the race there has one named time, no race start: «Iconițele astea tot nu sunt aliniate». The row read «Sâm., 21 nov. ·» on one line and «[clock] 10:00 (start eveniment)» wrapped under it: the clock inside the text column, 28 pixels right of the calendar, the time's digits further right than the date, a «·» dangling at the end of the first line. §600 had made the tidy list only for a race with both named times, and only below a viewport of 412 pixels — so a race with one named time never got it, and a two-times race between 412 pixels and its one-line width still showed the old two-line wrap.

**Decision.** One rule: the «când» row of a race — one named time or two (`whenTimes(...).times` with a `key`) — is the list form (a line per piece, no «·», the clock and the flag hung back into the glyph column under the calendar, so the date and every time start at one left edge) whenever the row's OWN box is narrower than the row's one-line width, and the inline form where it fits. A CSS container query decides, not a viewport media query: the card's text column beside the glyph (`flex: 1 1 auto`, so the size-contained box still fills the line), the hero's answer and the page's answer each declare `container-type: inline-size; container-name: when`, and the pieces take `@container when (max-width: 23em)` for one named time and `32em` for two. The em is the container's OWN (css-contain-3 resolves a container condition's em against the query container's font-size): 14 pixels on the card (`cardLine`'s `body2`), 16 on the hero and the page (`body1`). On the 14-pixel card the row is one line at «Sâm., 21 nov. · » 112 + the clock 24 + «10:00 (start eveniment)» 166 plus the gaps, about 22em, and with two times at 112 + 178 + 140 plus the gaps, about 31.5em (§597) — so the thresholds sit just above: 322 and 448 pixels on the card, 368 and 512 on the hero and the page. (A first cut at 20em and 28em, sized as if the card were 16 pixels, switched only below 280 pixels and left the 390-pixel phone, column 298, with exactly the wrap of the photograph; the review caught it.) A reader's larger font moves the threshold with the words; English is shorter, so the same em hold. `CARD_LIST_BELOW_412` and `LIST_BELOW_SM` are gone. The same markup as §600 (`data-when-line`, `data-when-separator`, the hung first glyph); only the at-rule changed. On the page the glyph hangs only below `sm`, where the answer is indented by the glyph column — from `sm` up the label column stands there, so a list there keeps the glyph in its seat; the hero has no glyph column and never hangs.

**What it means at a phone's widths.** The card's text column is at most about 320 pixels at 320, 360, 390 and 412: a two-times race is the three-line list at every phone width (412 included — it was two lines there), a one-named-time race the two-line list at 320, 360 and 390 (at 412 its column of about 320 pixels sits at the 322-pixel threshold). The e2e asserts the list form itself — every «·» `display: none`, every time's piece starting at the date's left edge — not merely the line count, which the old wrap matched too. A desktop card narrower than the threshold gets the list too, which is right.

**Unchanged.** Group runs, series and any bare time (`key: null`): no name, a short row, no list and no container. The emails and the `.ics` are plain text. No words, no catalogue key, no migration, no dependency. A browser without container queries (none since 2023) shows the inline form, as before.
changelogLine: - **The race's «când» lines up with one time too** — the race's card, hero and page draw the date and each named time on a line of their own, the clock and the flag under the calendar, wherever the row's own box is too narrow for one line (a container query, in em), not only for two times below 412 pixels. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Wherever a race's «când» row is narrower than its one-line width — measured on the row's own box, below 23em with one named time and 32em with two, in the row's own font-size — the card, the hero and the event page draw it as a list: the date and each named time on a line of their own, no middle dot, and on the card (and on the page below `sm`) the clock and the flag hung in the glyph column under the calendar so the date and every time start at one left edge; where the row fits it flows inline, and a bare time (a group run, a series) has no list (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: every race's «când» is a list where its own box is too narrow, one named time too (container query)
